add_claim.help: Add or update a claim in the ledger.

add_edge.help: Add a typed edge between nodes.

add_item.help: Add an immutable item. Returns its hash; the same content is the same item.

item.description: kind (choice|numeric|free), prompt, options+answer | answer+tolerance | rubric, explanation, hints, concepts, difficulty, supersedes

add_node.help: Add or update a graph node.

answer.help: Answer an item. Choice and numeric answers are checked now; free answers wait for a grade. dont_know=true instead of a response says "I don't know" (a miss, never a guess).

response.description: the answer: option index or text, a number, or free text

approve.help: A person approves, rejects or asks for changes to a plan.

ask.help: The learner asks a question, or asks for another explanation (mode).

mode.description: another explanation: simpler, more-rigorous, derivation, visual, analogy, worked-example, physical-interpretation, implementation, prerequisites

atlas.help: A graph laid out for drawing: knowledge (hubs and what you know of each, or one hub's or capability's neighbourhood) or research (question, hypothesis, experiment, claim, evidence, and what each needs you to know).

focus.description: a hub, capability or research node id to look at closely

automation.help: What the system has done on its own lately, and the jobs it has waiting.

brief.help: The first call of every session: what needs the person's judgement (with the evidence), what is happening, what they learned, what is new, and what to do next. Also makes anything that followed from changes happen now.

compact.description: just the next action and the counts

text.description: as the few lines a terminal shows

bundle_animate.help: Render a node's Manim animation from its spec and attach it.

spec.description: animation spec path inside the bundle

bundle_check.help: Run the readiness gate: every row with what is missing, and ready true or false.

bundle_create.help: Create a lesson bundle with its goal as the only node.

bundle_file.help: Write one file into a bundle (text, or base64 for binary), e.g. a visual or its RESULT note.

bundle_plan.help: Read a bundle's plan, or replace it with plan=... (validated; voids the last gate verdict).

bundle_tasks.help: Open one task per missing piece of a bundle for agents to make (and clip searches).

clips.description: also ask video scouts for clips

bundle_voice.help: Speak every narration segment without audio with a local engine.

env.description: a virtual environment holding the engine (or set RESEARCH_OS_VOICE_ENVS)

model_dir.description: Kokoro: the folder with kokoro-v1.0.onnx and voices-v1.0.bin

bundles.help: Prepared bundles with their goal and whether each is ready.

cancel.help: Withdraw an open task that is no longer needed, with the reason.

capabilities.help: Each capability in a scope with its state, readiness, frontier flag and what blocks it.

scope.description: a node id such as course:stat303 or capability:x (default: all)

chain.help: One claim and everything it rests on, laid out for drawing: its question and experiment, the audit steps with their verdicts, the files and sources, the decision and the handouts.

claim.help: Claim a task so no other agent takes it (the claim lapses after 30 minutes).

claim_status.help: One claim's audit status: verdict per step, missing steps, ownership, assurance met.

claims.help: The claims ledger: each claim's verdict over its required audits, ownership, and what is missing.

close.help: Close a lesson and write its log.

code.help: Code that implements a node, with Graphify symbols.

commit.help: Record one atomic commitment from a review comment, or resolve one (status=fulfilled|declined).

compute_request.help: Grant execution permission for an already human-approved exact staged plan. Trusted native code runs in a disposable directory, not an OS sandbox.

compute_stage.help: Stage code and immutable inputs as a proposed experiment; does not execute or change the original codebase.

compute_staged.help: Read the exact latest staged code and execution proposal.

context.help: Where this record stands, for an agent about to work: a project's research graph (next steps, claims) with the user's state in each capability it depends on; for the user-wide record, its knowledge and every linked project.

decide.help: A person decides on a claim (accepted, revise, rejected, retracted), question or proposal.

doctor.help: What is set up and what is not (vault, PDF toolchain, agent clients, jobs), each with the one command that fixes it.

due.help: Reviews due by FSRS from graded answers and retrieval history, soonest first.

engage.help: Start what the person asked for, in their own words: teach me a course or topic, investigate a question, review, or continue. Makes the records and the goal, opens the work for agents, and lets lessons, notes, handouts and literature follow on their own. Saying it again changes nothing.

intent.description: what the person said, in their words

kind.description: what it is (default: worked out from the words)

target.description: a short key: a course code like stat303, or a topic or question key

materials.description: where the course material is, or what it is (syllabus, textbook, a folder, a link)

evidence.help: Everything behind one decision: a claim's audit chain, numbers, citations, adversary memo, ownership and handouts; or an experiment plan and what approving it authorizes.

subject.description: the claim, experiment or proposal id from the queue

execution_configure.help: Set conservative workspace execution budgets. Native CLI internal inference calls are not a spend cap.

values.description: context characters, output tokens, tool_steps, deadline seconds, queue and provider_calls

execution_limits.help: Read workspace context, output, step, deadline, queue and local provider-call budgets.

export.help: Write this record's notes into an Obsidian vault (the same as vault_set + vault_sync), or a read-only single-file HTML snapshot.

path.description: the vault folder (obsidian) or the HTML file (static)

folder.description: folder inside the vault (default Research OS)

find.help: Find nodes by name or text across this record and the ones it is joined to, and notes in the vault.

finish.help: Finish a task with its result.

frontier.help: Capabilities ready to learn next: every prerequisite is ready and the capability is not yet retained.

gaps.help: What a target needs that the researcher does not yet have: the capabilities in its prerequisite closure that are not ready, which of them to start with, and which research steps they block.

target.description: what to plan for: a capability, course, goal, subject or project id, or a research node of a project record; several, comma-separated. Default: a project record's whole research, or the user-wide record's goals

goal.help: State what you want to master: a goal with the capabilities or hubs it covers, a deadline, a pace in minutes a week and a priority. Plan it with `roadmap --target goal:<key>`.

targets.description: node ids it covers: capability:x, or a course, subject, project or concept

grade.help: Grade an answer: correct, partially-correct or incorrect.

handout_attach.help: Attach the PDF a build job made for one version of a handout: verify it, place it in the vault and link it from the note.

handout.description: the handout id (handout:<key>) or its key

handout_build.help: Deliver a handout: write its note into the vault now and build its PDF (queued as a job, or now with wait) when the gate passes.

handout.description: the handout id (handout:<key>) or its key

wait.description: build the PDF now instead of queueing it

handout_check.help: Run a handout's readiness gate: sources, no answer keys, math, structure, figures; a failing row opens a task.

handout.description: the handout id (handout:<key>) or its key

handout_create.help: Start a handout (lecture, recitation, chapter, literature, findings) for a scope in this record: composes what the record knows and opens the task that asks an agent to write it.

scope.description: node ids it is about: capabilities, a course or subject, a question, an experiment

key.description: a short key (default from the title)

handout_file.help: Put an image a handout's sections refer to (figures/name.png) beside its source.

handout.description: the handout id (handout:<key>) or its key

handout_read.help: A handout's whole source: its sections as written, its sources and the context it is written from.

handout.description: the handout id (handout:<key>) or its key

handout_write.help: Write one section of a handout (Markdown, LaTeX math in $...$, boxes as :::definition, :::example, :::exercise ... === solution ... :::), with the sources it cites and the locators that ground it.

handout.description: the handout id (handout:<key>) or its key

section.description: the section id (its role, e.g. gist, lecture, evidence)

title.description: heading (to rename a section or add a new one)

locators.description: where what it states comes from: a page, section or source key

derivation.description: the section derives its results instead of citing them

sources.description: sources to add: {key, text}, cited in text as [@key]

handouts.help: Every handout of this record with its status (draft, ready, built) and where its PDF is.

hint.help: The next hint for an item, then its explanation.

history.help: Answers with their question and grade, oldest first: the newest 200 unless limit says otherwise.

limit.description: how many of the newest answers (default 200; 0 for all)

import.help: Import old files into this record (idempotent).

project.description: documents: the project id, project:<key>, they are about

item.help: One item. Hidden fields (key, rubric, explanation) only with reveal=true, for tutors and authors.

items.help: Items testing a capability or concept, easiest first (learner view).

concept.description: node id, e.g. capability:x or concept:y

job_done.help: Finish a local job with what the run reported, and do what it said to do next (attach the PDF).

jobs.help: Local engine runs waiting to be done by the process serving this record: a PDF build, a voice render.

library.help: Lesson logs and lessons, newest first.

link.help: Set a record up in the two graphs: with user_wide, it is the user-wide knowledge record; otherwise it is a project's or course's record, joined to the user-wide one (user, default the only one) under a hub id (project: or course:), with the hub created in both.

user.description: the user-wide record's name (default: the only one)

project.description: this record's hub id: project:<key> or course:<key> (default project:<record name>)

user_wide.description: this is the user-wide knowledge record

literature_search.help: Search public scholarly metadata. Queries leave this computer; candidates are not verified scientific evidence.

log.help: The Markdown log of a lesson.

map.help: The capability graph of a scope for drawing: nodes with state and position flags, requires edges.

migrate.help: Import a whole old vault (learning notes, sessions and their pages, research records, projects, notes, papers, research tasks, visuals, resources, handouts) and prove it: every answer arrived and every file is accounted for. Importing again adds only what is new.

research_root.description: where research records live, if not in the vault

migrate_check.help: Is everything in the old vault accounted for (read in, derived or retired, with the reason), and has anything been added or changed since the last migration? Changes nothing.

vault.description: the old vault (default: the one migrated)

next.help: The next step of a lesson, decided by the policy, with its reason.

notebook_jobs.help: Inspect notebook requests, execution permissions and stored versus fresh output results.

notebook_request.help: Request a committed scratch notebook trace or bounded mutation; execution is an explicit human permission.

mutation.description: one bounded source or cell mutation

execute.description: actually execute; false means dry run

notebook_result.help: Record an actual notebook worker result idempotently against its request.

notebook_start.help: Claim a queued notebook request exactly once before starting its external process.

operation_finish.help: Persist an actual engine result, never a model assertion of completion.

operation_list.help: Read actual scholarly retrieval and compute operation states and saved manifests.

operation_start.help: Claim a queued operation once and return its bound engine packet.

pedagogy_history.help: Read previous explanation variants and assistance with exact request and attempt attribution.

pedagogy_reply.help: Save tutor feedback against the original request, item version and attempt without grading another answer.

pedagogy_request.help: Request an explanation, tiered practice, raw-summary comparison, terms or bounded analogy without awarding mastery.

precheck.help: Check every number a claim cites against its result file, before any audit.

root.description: project root the file paths are relative to

progress.help: What you did each week (answers, correct unaided answers, reviews, lessons, newly known capabilities) and where you stand: states, due reviews, estimated recall.

propose.help: Propose a change to a skill or the policy; only a human decision applies it.

provider_configure.help: Save an explicit model connection and capability profile without invoking inference.

endpoint.description: HTTP loopback endpoint, or empty for native CLI

model.description: installed or explicitly configured model id

provider_profiles.help: List explicitly configured local model endpoints and their declared capabilities.

queue.help: The decision queue: everything waiting for the researcher.

rebuild.help: Drop and rebuild the index from the record's files.

reconcile.help: Look at what changed in this record and do what follows from it on its own: request audits for new claims, queue the run of an approved experiment, prepare the next lessons, check handouts, update the vault. Runs by itself after every change; call it to make it happen now.

mode.description: call (cheap, the default), tick, scan or daily

records.help: Every record (course, project, user-wide) with its role and hub, and which one this is.

remove.help: Remove a graph node (id) or an edge (src, type, dst). The removal is recorded; history is kept.

request_audits.help: Open audit tasks for each required step without a verdict (claim text and paths only).

research.help: The next mechanical transition of each research record (unranked).

roadmap.help: The order in which to learn what a target needs: waves of capabilities that can be studied in any order, each with why, effort, what it unlocks and where to start; with a pace (minutes a week) and a deadline, a schedule and whether it is feasible.

target.description: what to plan for: a capability, course, goal, subject or project id, or a research node of a project record; several, comma-separated. Default: a project record's whole research, or the user-wide record's goals

pace.description: minutes of study a week (default: the goal's)

deadline.description: ISO date to finish by (default: the goal's)

roadmap_tasks.help: Ask for the lesson material the roadmap's steps lack: one task for each step with no questions and no prepared lesson (idempotent).

target.description: what to plan for: a capability, course, goal, subject or project id, or a research node of a project record; several, comma-separated. Default: a project record's whole research, or the user-wide record's goals

run_get.help: Inspect one saved execution and its partial output and operation references.

run_list.help: Read saved runs including explicit terminal states and committed tool results.

run_output.help: Checkpoint a batch of partial output, preserving it across reconnects and crashes.

run_step.help: Record a committed operation result exactly once for its operation identifier.

run_transition.help: Record a validated execution lifecycle transition without inferring completion from age.

run_usage.help: Preserve provider-reported usage and cost distinctly from unavailable or estimated values.

source_capture.help: Retain an immutable source revision and capture a bounded passage with exact line locators.

source_change.help: Pause, resume or disconnect a source without deleting any original files.

source_children.help: Browse one directory lazily within an existing source connection.

source_engine_root.help: Resolve a registered codebase for an explicitly requested local engine job.

source_index_batch.help: Incrementally index at most twenty approved source files in a rebuildable lexical cache.

source_list.help: List source connections and their current availability without scanning their contents.

source_location.help: Resolve a connected local path for an explicit host open or reveal action.

source_preview.help: Preview a local file or retained cited revision without executing its contents.

source_protect_derived.help: Mark a record as containing local-only derived material; cloud turns remain blocked.

source_register.help: Connect a local file, folder, vault or codebase without scanning or executing it.

source_relocate.help: Explicitly relocate a connection while retaining its source and external record identity.

source_report.help: Record a completed source engine report without modifying the original repository.

source_reports.help: Read saved understanding coverage reports for one connected codebase.

source_search.help: Search an explicitly indexed connection with bounded local excerpts and source revisions.

source_use_vault.help: Use a connected vault for Research OS projection without importing or synchronizing any notes.

folder.description: generated Research OS folder inside the vault

start.help: Start a lesson and get the first step. On a bundle it starts only when the bundle is ready.

scope.description: what to learn: capability:x, course:y, concept:z ... (default: the bundle's goal)

status.help: What is in this record: capabilities and their states, due reviews, open tasks, lessons, problems.

as_of.description: ISO date to assess on (default today)

support.help: What supports or invalidates a claim or other node.

tasks.help: Work waiting for an agent: grade, answer, visual, narration, animation, video, audit, verify, scout, ingest, outline, bundle, handout, run (job tasks are for the portal or MCP process).

state.description: open (default), claimed, done, cancelled or all

teach.help: Record that a capability was taught, how, and with what content.

today.help: The home page: reviews due, the next lesson (ready or what is missing), answers waiting for the tutor.

transcription_accept.help: Mark an exact transcription draft reviewed by a person; original scan and prior drafts remain unchanged.

transcription_draft.help: Save a faithful transcription draft bound to an immutable scan revision; retain uncertainty and apparent mistakes.

transcription_list.help: Read preserved scan transcription drafts and human review receipts.

vault_find.help: Find notes of this record by title text, kind, record id or tag (an indexed lookup, not a scan).

vault_note.help: Where one note (and its PDF) is: path, Obsidian link, portal link.

id.description: the record id of the note

vault_resolve.help: Act on drift: update lets the record rewrite a note you edited (your edit is kept under My notes), restore brings back a note you deleted, reviewed marks an agent-written note as read and accepted.

target.description: the note's record id or its path in the vault

vault_review.help: Write today's review note in the vault: what is due, learned, decided and added.

vault_root.help: The vault folder Research OS writes into (absolute), or nothing when no vault is set.

vault_set.help: Choose the Obsidian vault (and the folder inside it, default 'Research OS') that holds the notes, PDFs and decisions; with no arguments it finds Obsidian's vaults and uses the only one.

root.description: the folder inside the vault (default Research OS)

vault_status.help: What is out of step in the vault: notes you edited, deleted or added, links that do not resolve, attachments nothing links to. Changes nothing.

deep.description: also count every file under the folder

vault_sync.help: Bring the vault in step with this record: read what you changed there, then write the notes the record changed. Incremental; dry_run says what would be written.

dry_run.description: write nothing, say what would be written

full.description: look at every note, not only what changed

verdict.help: Record an audit verdict. The claim's author cannot audit it.

checklist.description: integrity: each failure mode ok or concern

vision_dispatch_check.help: Check a consumed media permission still matches its exact queued turn and configured destination.

vision_permission.help: Grant one turn permission for this exact retained image/PDF and configured destination. Local-only sources remain blocked.

waive.help: A person accepts the risk of not being able to defend a claim.

work.help: Take the next task waiting for an agent, across every record: claimed for you, with the skill to read, the role to play and the tool that finishes it. Say who you are; call it again when you finish.

by.description: who is working: your name or agent id

kinds.description: only these kinds of task (default: the most urgent of any)

workspace_activity.help: See what was completed, what is running and what happens next, with recent recorded research actions and honest task states.

workspace_chat.help: Read the messages and pending response of one conversation. Assistant messages are not scientific or learning evidence.

workspace_chat_complete.help: Append the response or failure for a saved message, idempotently, without creating assessment evidence or human decisions.

workspace_chat_send.help: Save a conversational message and prepare its model request; the portal executes the optional provider outside the record lock.

conversation.description: existing conversation id; omit to start and frame a goal

workspace_cloud_guard.help: Check indexed privacy restrictions in the record and linked context before cloud access.

workspace_connections.help: Read the selected record and configured vault connection without discovery, scans, sync or migration.

workspace_document.help: Read a handout, lesson transcript or imported source as versioned document data, with stable sections and provenance.

workspace_entity.help: Read one entity with its incoming and outgoing typed references, including missing targets and cross-record links.

limit.description: at most 200 incoming and outgoing references; default 80

workspace_graph.help: Read a bounded graph neighbourhood with original directed typed edges and provenance for the interactive workspace.

focus.description: canonical node id; omit for hub overview

depth.description: neighbourhood hops, between zero and three

workspace_lesson_material.help: Open prepared sections freely without marking them learned; record assistance before assessment material is exposed.

item.description: current immutable assessment item, if any

workspace_resolve.help: Resolve an exact id, title or alias across linked records; return ambiguous or missing references explicitly.

target.description: node id, exact alias, wikilink or record::id with optional #anchor

workspace_sessions.help: List canonical conversations with pagination independent of browser preferences.
